note: Topics U1, 13 Oct 2026. Sentences written by hand for the gambling list v1, two-sided: every `matches` sentence must be found and every `clean` sentence must not be. The clean side is the hard side: ordinary uses of the same letters (better/bet, scraps/craps, bookmarked/bookie) and ordinary English that other languages' lists would catch (the odds, a jackpot, aviator sunglasses). A sentence moves between the sides only with the list's author in the same commit. These are written sentences, not counts: the measured collision count over real posts is Topics U3.
